styleLock.direction: industrial machined-fastener ecommerce, dark technical catalogue with one warm accent
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating full-width bands: #0B0B0C studio void with fine dust-particle bokeh, and #F1F0EE neutral panel with #FFFFFF rounded tiles; depth always shallow and uncluttered
styleLock.lightingSystem: single hard raking key from the left, specular streaks along machined thread crests and knurled rims, deep falloff to #0B0B0C, crisp contact shadow under every part, 5000K on scene screens; no fill flattening the texture
styleLock.surfaceSystem: #1A1A1C fine-grit metal-filing strip in the lower third of dark screens, matte #F1F0EE board on light screens, brushed machined steel as the only material read
styleLock.typography: bold condensed geometric sans-serif headlines with hairline vertical rules, rounded pill tags with 1px outlines, small tracked body lines; one family only, Chinese copy always wrapped in corner brackets
styleLock.iconSystem: thin 1px line icons inside rounded-square frames on #0B0B0C, plus solid square numbered badges in #E8940F with light numerals; no filled pictograms, no 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: parts presented as an aligned ascending ladder or a tight diagonal cluster; identical scale within a screen; drive recess and thread crest are the two faces that must read; straight shanks never curved or tapered by the lens
noDrift: no palette changes and no extra accent hues
no mixed fonts or serif or handwritten lettering
no mismatched icon weights or badge shapes
no painted, plated or coloured coatings on the parts
no rendered numbers, grades or certifications
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: premium industrial machined-fastener ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of graphite-black #0B0B0C, charcoal grit surface #1A1A1C, neutral light panel #F1F0EE, clean #FFFFFF rounded tiles, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and exactly one accent #E8940F; neutral tone with that single warm accent; bold condensed geometric sans-serif headlines with hairline vertical rules and rounded pill tags; alternating dark-band and light-band layout system with thin 1px outlined rounded-square icon frames and solid square numbered accent badges; hard raking side light from the left producing specular streaks along machined thread crests and knurled head rims, deep falloff into #0B0B0C, fine dust-particle bokeh, and a real contact shadow under every part; bare machined stainless-steel material rendering with visible thread flanks and hexagonal drive recesses, no coatings, no paint; stable product scale, aligned rows, no perspective warp of straight shanks; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or badges.

provenance.notes: 由 9 张详情页切片提炼。源夹为五金，按内置品类表落到 L1=家装灯具 / L2=五金（紧固件属五金），与源夹一致，不存在 L1 不符。已剥离：品牌胶囊字样与拉丝金属字标题造型、内六角孔端面刻印、售后条款原文、入会角标与二维码、四色涂层色值。所有数值（材质牌号与强度等级、螺纹规格、长度、件数、公差）一律改为 {callout_*} 占位符，由生成时按真实商品参数注入；源参数屏为通用模板残留（含与紧固件无关的电压字段），故未继承任何数字，亦无任何认证、检测、销量主张。视觉体系刻意与库内既有工具箱套装、活动扳手、老虎钳、百叶轮、锂电钻错开：以六角孔、螺纹掠射侧光、规格阶梯与俯视规格矩阵为主题语法。
